item.tib: rgyal po 'phrul ldan gyi bstod bskul
item.coloph: zhes pa 'di skyang nam bdag gis chu bya hor zla'i tshes la nyams la thol shar ma bkag par bris pa 'di/ bden nam rdzun gang yin cha med/ dam pa nyid kyi thugs rtsis bzhes na rten 'brel brtag la spyod par zhu zhu/ ces pa 'di spral sku tshe dbang mchog legs kyis nged tshang gi dgon pa la cho 'phrul can gyi rgyal po zhig 'dug pas/ 'di bkar bskrad kyis ma byung zhing bsten mchod byed dgos 'dra bas/ khyed kyis 'di la bskal pa zhig bris dang gsungs pas der bdag gis cir yang mi shes kyang 'di ltar snyems pa'i rtog blo yid bzo kho na byas pa yin te/ khong gi mnyes mnyes mdzad nas bsnams song ba la dpe bshus pa'o//
